title: Ministry of Women and Child Development reviews progress of Special Campaign 6 for Swachhata and Grievance Disposal
subtitle:
109 State and UT officials participate in high-level review; focus on daily reporting, portal integration, and resolution of pending references by October 30
Dedicated one-day special event scheduled for October 30 with active community and field-worker participation
body_text: Ministry of Women and Child Development, including all Autonomous/ Statutory Bodies under its administrative control, has initiated efforts and finalised action plans & targets to implement Special Campaign 6 for improving Swachhata and disposal of pending references from 2nd October - 31st October, 2026. As part of the implementation phase of Special Campaign 6, Ministry of Women & Child Development has requested the States/UTs to undertake the following activities on a daily basis: Cleanliness Drives at Field-Level Institutions Effective Public Grievance Redressal and organizing Grievance Redressal Chaypal/e-Chaupals Document and upload activities on the different Mission portals of the Ministry Further, States/UTs have been requested to organise a dedicated special one-day event on 30 th October, 2026 by undertaking the said activities on a large scale with active participation of field-level functionaries and the community. In this regard, a VC meeting was convened under the Chairmanship of Secretary(WCD) on 26.10.2026 at 05.00 P.M. with States/UTs to review the activities being undertaken by States/UTs under the campaign. All the Additional Secretaries/ Joint Secretaries and Directors/Deputy Secretaries dealing with the schemes of the Ministry and 109 Officers from the States/UTs participated in the VC. Secretary(WCD) directed all States/UTs to issue directions to the concerned Officers for undertaking the said activities in all the field institutions and to upload the details on the respective Mission portals. He also advised the States/UTs to publish and share infographics and tweets on a daily basis through the social media handles of the State Government highlighting the activities undertaken and tagging the relevant official social media handles of the Ministry. Further, he urged them to ensure that all pending grievances on POSHAN Tracker and PMMVY and CPGRAMS portal are resolved on a war footing by 30.10.2026 by organising Grievance Redressal Chaupal/e-Chaupals. *** RC/PC
